title: Sharks Have Vanished From The Open Ocean Since 1970
hook: Nobody saw the ocean's sharks disappearing.
closing: Apex predator. Zero say in its own survival.
question: Did you know sharks were disappearing this fast?

segments.say: In 1970, oceanic sharks and rays were near their historic numbers. By 2018, 71 percent of them were gone.
The worst hit was the oceanic whitetip shark, down 98 percent from one of the most common sharks in the ocean.
Today, 75 percent of these shark species are threatened with extinction.
